instruction: Candid medium photograph of a group on a rooftop terrace. From left to right, a blonde woman (R1) in a striped jumpsuit smiles, a man with a white cap (R2) in a white t-shirt holds a cupcake, a woman with tied-back hair (R4) in a black top claps, a dark-haired woman (R3) in a striped crop top claps, and a curly-haired woman (R7) in a striped dress claps. They are gathered closely, smiling and celebrating under bright, warm daylight.
